name: mandi-platform
description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for agricultural market management

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:client
scripts.install:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm install 2>/dev/null || true); done
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build:client
scripts.build:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm run build 2>/dev/null || true); done
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:client
scripts.test:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm test 2>/dev/null || true); done
